info.description:
Analyse a git diff (optionally with a repository snapshot and a coverage report) and receive a structured risk report. Every finding states its provenance (deterministic, heuristic, or AI-generated), severity and confidence separately, and cites evidence extracted from the inputs.

Authentication: when the server is configured with API keys, send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-API-Key`.
